mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_cash_out_report (report_date,user_id,wallet_type,start_online_times,start_online_amt,online_success_times,online_success_amt,false_success_times,false_success_amt,manual_success_times,manual_success_amt,fee,channel_fee,marketer_fee) SELECT #{date},user_id,wallet_type,SUM(start_times),SUM(start_amt),SUM(online_times),SUM(online_amt),0,0,SUM(manual_times),SUM(manual_amt),SUM(fee),SUM(channel_fee),SUM(marketer_fee) FROM ( SELECT user_id,wallet_type,1 start_times,order_amt start_amt,0 online_times,0 online_amt,0 manual_times,0 manual_amt,0 fee,0 channel_fee,0 marketer_fee FROM s_cash_out_order WHERE order_type=1 AND order_time >= #{date} AND order_time < DATE_ADD(#{date},INTERVAL 1 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT user_id,wallet_type,0,0,IF(order_type=1,1,0),IF(order_type=1,order_amt,0),IF(order_type=2,1,0),IF(order_type=2,order_amt,0),COALESCE(fee,0),COALESCE(channel_fee,0),COALESCE(marketer_fee,0) FROM s_cash_out_order WHERE status=5 AND cash_out_time >= #{date} AND cash_out_time < DATE_ADD(#{date},INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) facts GROUP BY user_id,wallet_type
